layout.billingGrace: Your last payment failed. Your plan stays active until {date}. Update your payment method to keep it.
layout.billingOverdue: Your payment is overdue, so this team is on the Free plan until it goes through.
layout.overLimit: This team is over the {plan} plan limits ({items}). Everything stays available, but nothing new can be added until you remove some or upgrade.

kinds.payment_failed: A payment for {team} failed. Update the payment method before the grace period ends.
kinds.trial_ending: The free trial of {team} ends on {date}.

welcome.tagline: A multi-tenant SaaS starter: teams, roles, plans and an audit log, ready to run locally with no paid keys.

forgot.title: Forgot Password
forgot.intro: Forgot your password? No problem. Just let us know your email address and we will email you a password reset link that will allow you to choose a new one.

confirm.title: Confirm Password
confirm.intro: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.

verify.title: Email Verification
verify.intro: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
verify.sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.introRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
twoFactor.introCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

projectShow.exportTitle: Export is included in Pro and Business

attachments.tooBig: That file is larger than {mb} MB.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.note: Entries are kept in English, whatever language they were made in.

team.title: Team
team.confirmTransfer: Make {name} the owner? You will become an admin.
team.deleteBlurb: Deletes {team} with its projects, tasks and activity history, and ends its subscription. Members are told by email. This cannot be undone.

billing.title: Billing
billing.using: Using {projects} projects, {members} members (including pending invitations) and {storage} of file storage.
billing.trial: You're on a free trial until {date}. Cancel before then and you won't be charged.
billing.updatePaymentHint: Change your card or download receipts at Stripe.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.failed: We couldn't load your invoices right now. Please try again later.

billing.ownerOnly: Only the team owner can change the plan.

info.title: Profile Information
info.intro: Update your account's profile information and email address.
info.name: Name
info.emailHint: We will email a link to the new address. Your email only changes once you open it.
info.pending: Waiting for you to confirm {email}. Open the link we sent there to finish the change.
info.resend: Click here to re-send the verification email.
info.linkSent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.

password.title: Update Password
password.intro: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.

export.title: Download your data
export.intro: Get a copy of the personal data we hold about you as a JSON file: your account, your teams and roles, your invitations and the activity you caused. Team content such as projects and tasks belongs to the team and is not included.
export.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
export.tooMany: You have downloaded your data too often. Please try again later.
export.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete Account
delete.intro: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.
delete.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete.confirmBody: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in, on top of your password.
twoFactor.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe.
twoFactor.codesOnce: Each works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.codesLeft: You have {count} recovery code left. | You have {count} recovery codes left.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: Let a script or another tool work with the projects and tasks of one of your teams. A token has your role in that team and is shown only once.
apiTokens.onlyOnce: It will not be shown again.
apiTokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{name}”? Anything using it stops working at once.
apiTokens.name: Name

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.intro: You can sign in with these. If you signed up with one and never chose a password, use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page to set one: it is asked for before sensitive changes.
connected.confirm: Disconnect {provider}? You can still sign in with your password.
